title: DatasetCase
description: One line of a dataset file <name>/<major.minor.patch>.jsonl. Relevance is labelled by asset version and time span, not by chunk, so the dataset stays valid across chunking strategies and rebuilds. A source is relevant when it overlaps a relevant span of the same asset version, and leaks when it overlaps a forbidden one.

relevant.description: Spans a correct search finds; empty for an unanswerable question, whose correct answer is a refusal.

forbidden.description: Spans the caller must never see, for access-control cases.

reference_answer.description: The expected answer, for a judge.

tags.description: Labels the aggregates are broken down by.

caller_entitlements.description: Entitlements the question is asked under; none sees nothing. Printable ASCII without spaces or commas, since they travel in a comma-separated header.

asset_version.description: Content hash of the asset version; what sources are matched by.
